about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.text1: Full-stack web and mobile developer, recently graduated in Computer Science (Software Engineering) from Université Adventiste Zurcher. I build modern web and mobile applications with React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript.
about.text2: My final-year project, AllMada, is a Malagasy e-commerce marketplace made of a web app, a mobile app and a shared backend. I worked on REST APIs, JWT authentication, multi-role management (admin, sellers, customers), shops, products, orders and payments, as well as MongoDB, Docker and Git/GitHub.
about.text3: What I bring to you: clean and readable code, clear communication, on-time delivery, and real attention to detail so your project works from day one.
about.p1desc: Readable, tested, object-oriented code that's ready to grow with your project.
about.p2desc: From design to going live: mockups, development, testing, deployment.
about.p3desc: Your satisfaction and your project's success are my priorities.
about.infoEducationValue: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Université Adventiste Zurcher, 2023 – 2026
about.infoAvailabilityValue: Available for missions, internships and freelance projects

allmada.title: AllMada — E-commerce Marketplace
allmada.subtitle: Web & Mobile Platform
allmada.description: Final-year project: design and development of a Malagasy web and mobile marketplace with an architecture close to professional e-commerce platforms. Dual administration: a platform administrator supervises the marketplace, while each seller has their own shop to manage products, orders and activities.
highlights: Full-stack architecture: Web (Angular), Mobile and Backend (NestJS).
JWT authentication and role management (Admin, Sellers, Customers).
Secure payment integration with Stripe.
Product, order, and shop management.
Full containerization with Docker and Docker Compose.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Bilingual website
portfolio.description: Bilingual (FR/EN) portfolio designed and built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 and Framer Motion. Smooth animations, contact form via Resend, automatic deployment on Vercel. Modern, responsive and SEO-optimized design.
highlights: Modern, clean design with dark/light mode.
Full internationalization (French / English).
Smooth scroll animations with Framer Motion.
Functional contact form via Resend API.
Continuous deployment on Vercel via GitHub.

plume-relais.title: Plume Relais
plume-relais.subtitle: Collaborative Writing
plume-relais.description: Mobile collaborative writing app where each participant blindly adds a paragraph to an ongoing story. At each round, multiple continuations are proposed and the community votes for the official one. A blend of exquisite corpse and writing social network, in real time.
highlights: Blind relay mechanic to surprise participants.
Real-time voting system to choose the canon continuation.
Authentication and real-time sync via Supabase.
Notifications for new rounds and votes.
Smooth and intuitive interface with React Native.

invisible-queue.title: Invisible Queue
invisible-queue.subtitle: Virtual Waiting Lines
invisible-queue.description: Mobile app that digitizes physical waiting lines. Users join a nearby queue, track their real-time position and get notified as their turn approaches. Supabase for authentication and real-time sync, guest or logged-in mode, delay and turn management, mandatory geolocation.
highlights: Strict geolocation: you can only join queues nearby.
Real-time position tracking without refreshing.
Guest mode (no account) or authenticated (Supabase Auth).
Smart delay management (3-place setback, exclusion after 3 delays).
Queue creation reserved for logged-in users.

sonicflow.title: SonicFlow
sonicflow.subtitle: Native Android Music Player
sonicflow.description: Android music player that plays tracks from the device: library by artists, albums and genres, playlists, favorites and background playback.
highlights: Library sorted by artists, albums and genres (Room).
Background playback with notification (Media3 / ExoPlayer).
Mini-player and generated waveform visualization.
Sleep timer and playback modes (shuffle, repeat).
Jetpack Compose and Material 3 UI with glassmorphism effect.

bible.title: Bible Mobile App
bible.subtitle: Reading & meditation
bible.description: Mobile app with navigation, multilingual support and backend services integration.
highlights: Smooth and intuitive navigation.
Multilingual support for reading.
Backend services integration (Supabase).

items.description: Internship during my second year of studies. SLife Tracker is a company specialized in vehicle geolocation in Madagascar. I worked on a two-person project, learning development best practices and project management.
tasks: Developed a secure web application as a pair (authentication, role management, APIs)
Used JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React.js, NestJS and Express
Integrated REST APIs and secured authentication
Learned and practiced Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) for Agile project management
Introduction to the project manager role: planning, task tracking and team collaboration

items.description: Volunteer redesign of HELP Madagascar's website, an NGO active since 2000 in Toamasina, alongside the SPARK cohort from Université Adventiste Zurcher.
tasks: Designed a trilingual website, fast even on low connections
Developed a reliable and traceable online donation engine
Integrated payment methods suited to Madagascar
Built a simple back-office for the local team
